# OpsAgent

> A read-only ops agent for your cloud. A full scan every night, a calm morning briefing, and urgent exposures checked every 15 minutes and alerted right away. It never changes anything.

## Pages
- [Home](https://opsagent.dev/)
- [How it works](https://opsagent.dev/how-it-works): Connect read-only, checks run, you get a morning briefing.
- [What it checks](https://opsagent.dev/features/checks): Ten deterministic, read-only checks; every finding cites its evidence.
- [Alerts](https://opsagent.dev/features/alerts): Urgent exposures in Slack within minutes.
- [Connect your agent](https://opsagent.dev/features/agents): Claude, Cursor or any MCP client; read-only unless you approve changes.
- [Dashboard AI](https://opsagent.dev/features/ai-and-review): AI explains findings once an owner turns it on.
- [Connect docs](https://opsagent.dev/docs/connect-your-agent): How to connect an MCP client; read-only unless you approve changes.
- [OpsAgent vs AWS DevOps Agent](https://opsagent.dev/compare/aws-devops-agent): Nightly read-only checks for a flat price vs incident investigations billed per agent-second; sourced and dated.
- [OpsAgent vs Cleric](https://opsagent.dev/compare/cleric): Nightly read-only checks for a flat price vs alert and release investigations priced in credits; sourced and dated.
- [OpsAgent vs Trusted Advisor and Security Hub](https://opsagent.dev/compare/trusted-advisor-security-hub): Which Trusted Advisor checks each AWS support plan unlocks and how Security Hub is priced, next to OpsAgent's flat price; sourced and dated.
- [Sample report](https://opsagent.dev/sample-report): A morning briefing and findings anonymised from a real scan of our own AWS account.
- [Security group checker](https://opsagent.dev/tools/security-group-check): Free, runs in your browser. Paste aws ec2 describe-security-groups output and see which groups leave SSH or a database port open to the world.
- [IAM credential report checker](https://opsagent.dev/tools/iam-credential-report-check): Free, runs in your browser. Paste your IAM credential report and see root use, missing MFA, old keys and unused keys.
- [Pricing](https://opsagent.dev/pricing): Flat per cloud account, Starter US$99, Team US$299, Scale US$599 a month, plus tax where applicable.
- [Security](https://opsagent.dev/security): Read-only by design.
- [Privacy](https://opsagent.dev/privacy)
- [Terms](https://opsagent.dev/terms)
